verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's own feature docs say connected Gmail or Outlook email comes with templates, and that sequenced campaigns can be sent to a filtered list from inside the CRM, with engagement flowing back to the contact record. That covers both templated emails and multi-step sequences, but each is only a one-line marketing claim. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of sequence step configuration (delays, branching, stop conditions), detail on template management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM

citations.quote: Connect Gmail or Outlook so every customer email is logged against the right contact and deal automatically, with tracking and templates.
Send sequenced campaigns to a filtered list from inside the CRM, with engagement flowing back onto the contact record.
